name: How do I choose the right general contractor for my project?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right general contractor for my project?

acceptedAnswer.text: To choose the right general contractor, start by checking their licenses, insurance, and references. Look for contractors with experience in projects similar to yours and review their portfolios. Request detailed bids from at least three different contractors to compare costs and proposed timelines. Pay attention to their communication style and ensure they are responsive and transparent, as clear communication is crucial for a successful project.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a general contractor by checking licenses, insurance, references, and experience. Compare detailed bids and assess their communication skills.
